Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — DPA redline and SOC 2 window

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs at Asteria want to tighten the MAP timeline so we can get to procurement by mid-November. Two items blocking our side: the DPA redline (legal wants to see retention language finalized) and the SOC 2 snapshot / auditor statement.

I've attached our latest DPA redline for you to review (DPA_redline_v3.docx). Can your team confirm the retention tiers you support (particularly: 90 days, 12 months, or longer-term archival options)? Also: are you able to provide SOC 2 scope and the most recent report snapshot for review?

Proposed MAP milestones from our side:
- By 11/03: final DPA commentary
- By 11/08: SOC 2 evidence review complete
- By 11/12: procurement pricing approval

Let me know if those are achievable. If helpful, I can loop in our security lead.

Best,
Alice
Alice Romero
Head of Procurement, Asteria Health

Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — DPA redline and SOC 2 window

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear milestones. We can align to that MAP cadence with a couple notes from our side.

Quick answers up front:
- Retention tiers: we support configurable retention windows per customer. Standard tiers we operate as: 90 days (default), 12 months (mid-tier), and archival (multi-year with escrow/backup) — archival would require an annex and different SLA.
- SOC 2: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report snapshot and a control matrix extract by 11/04.

Next steps I propose:
1) Kimberly will lead the SIG/CAIQ clarifications and produce a short Q&A doc for your security team by 11/03.
2) I will review the DPA redline tonight and send our comments by 11/03 noon PT.
3) Connor will coordinate the DocuSign flow and finalize who signs and when once we agree on retention language.

I'll attach the SOC2_agreement_snapshot.pdf for your intake team to review while Kimberly builds the CAIQ answers.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOC2_agreement_snapshot.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

Subject: SIG/CAIQ Q&A and retention proposal for Asteria

Evelyn / Connor / Alice —

I've pulled together the SIG/CAIQ clarifications based on the questions Asteria typically raises. High level: there are three small items where we ask for confirmation from Asteria (data residency, backup snapshots retention, and agent access for evaluation). I've attached a short spreadsheet with our suggested answers: SIG_CAIX_answers.xlsx.

Retention specifics I'm proposing to include in the DPA redline (suggested language snippet):
- Session and transient inference logs: retained up to 90 days by default; can be extended to 12 months for an additional fee.
- Customer-managed persistent data (customer files uploaded for evaluation): retained per customer request; default archival policy is disabled unless explicitly enabled and covered in annex.
- Audit logs and SOC 2 evidence artifacts: retained 24 months in the secure evidence store; can be exported to escrow on request.

Open question for Asteria: do you require a 7-year archival (common for healthcare regulatory records) or is 24 months + export/escrow sufficient for your procurement/legal? If you need 7 years we will route through our archival addendum and ops runbook — that typically adds procurement lead time.

I'll be standing by to fold Kimberly's redline suggestions into Evelyn's DPA response.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SIG_CAIX_answers.xlsx (XLSX, 56KB)

Alice — quick summary and next steps from Redwood's side so we can hit your procurement window: 

1) DPA: Evelyn will send our redline by EOD 11/03 (we plan to accept most commercial points; archival language will be an annex if needed).
2) SIG/CAIQ: Kimberly's spreadsheet contains proposed answers; if Asteria security has follow-ups we can schedule a 30-min drop-in on 11/05.
3) SOC2: Evelyn shared the snapshot; if you need the full report we will coordinate an NDA/secure transfer.
4) Retention: please confirm whether you need 7-year archival or if 24 months + escrow/export is acceptable. Once confirmed we will finalize the DPA clause and route DocuSign.

DocuSign link (provisional): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/ABCDEF123456
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/98765 (deal AST-2027-09)

If you confirm "24 months + escrow" we can keep everything on the standard MAP path and hit 11/12 procurement. If you require 7-year archival, please flag so we can scope the archival annex and escalate timelines.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.

Connor
